options.label: Hide Open App and Sign Up buttons
options.description: The Sign Up and Open App buttons in the top bar of the home and browse pages.

options.label: Hide display ad overlay on streams
options.description: The display-ad slot layered over the live player. Video ads that play inside the stream itself cannot be hidden.

options.label: Hide suggested categories and curated rows
options.description: The 'Categories we think you'll like' row and the themed stream rows (Music, Team FPS...) on Home. Live on Twitch stays.

options.label: Hide stream and category tags
options.description: The small tag pills (language, genre, DropsEnabled) under stream and category cards.

options.label: Hide live chat
options.description: The scrolling chat messages next to or under a live stream. The Send Chat box stays.

options.label: Hide Subscribe button
options.description: The Subscribe button on channel pages and profiles; Follow stays.

meta.notes: LIVE (headless Chromium, iPhone UA 390x844, logged out, 2026-11-08): https://m.twitch.tv/ nav a[href*=tt_medium=mweb]=1 (Open App, top-bar), nav > div:has(> a[...]) > button=1 (Sign Up), 'Categories we think you'll like' row matched by div:has(> div > h2 > a[href="/directory"])=1, collection rows div:has(> div > h2 > a[href^="/directory/collection/"])=4 at top of Home (more rows lazy-load and the list is virtualised), [aria-label^="Tag, "]=108 on Home (buttons and links; also on /directory/all and category pages). https://m.twitch.tv/pathofexile (live channel, waited ~35 s, no timed prompt seen): [data-a-target=chat-scroller]=1, button[aria-label=Subscribe]=1, [data-test-selector=sda-wrapper]=1 (the slot existed but was empty, so the overlay is not seen rendering; harmless best-effort). Subscribe=1 also on /pathofexile/videos. Video pre-roll ads in the player (VOD /videos/<id> showed 'Ad 1 of 2' with a Learn More button) run inside the player and are deliberately NOT hidden. Not found logged out: cookie banner, notification prompt, drops/Prime promo tiles, marketplace/AI modules, floating action buttons (no rules written). /activity is only an 'Open App for Activity' page and /directory/following a log-in prompt: left alone, they are the page's content. Fixtures hand-distilled from the observed DOM. NOT verified: logged-in views, other regions' consent dialogs, clips and schedule tabs, desktop www.twitch.tv layout (recipe also matches it), whether sda-wrapper ever carries a visible ad.
